name: Saint Athanasius
history: Bishop of Alexandria for forty-five years, Athanasius was the great defender of the faith of Nicaea, that the Son is true God, of one substance with the Father. Exiled five times by four emperors, he never gave way. He wrote On the Incarnation and the Life of Antony, and is a Doctor of the Church.
life: As a young deacon Athanasius went with his bishop Alexander to the Council of Nicaea in 325, which condemned Arius’s teaching that the Son was a creature. Three years later he succeeded Alexander as bishop. The Arian party, often supported by the imperial court, worked to remove him, and he was banished five times, to Trier in Gaul, to Rome and, more than once, to hiding among the monks of the Egyptian desert. In all he spent about seventeen years in exile. His short book On the Incarnation explains why the Word became flesh: to restore the image of God in us and to overcome death. His Life of Antony spread the ideal of monastic life through the West. In his Easter letter of 367 he listed the twenty-seven books of the New Testament as we have them. He died in Alexandria in 373, at peace with his flock.
prayerTo: Saint Athanasius, you stood for the truth that Jesus Christ is God, though emperors and bishops turned against you. Pray for the Church in every age of confusion, and for me, that I may hold fast to the faith, worship the Son as true God, and not fear standing alone. Amen.
penance: Pray the Nicene Creed slowly today, bowing at the words of the Incarnation. Pray for bishops who are under pressure to bend the truth.
meditation: He became man so that we might be made god. What does it mean for you that God wishes to share His own life with you?
